rationale: The eventual path candidate is structured_delivery because the change introduces product semantics and affects runtime and policy across six canonical owners, while deterministic propagation is absent for derived paths. This excludes verified_change, and compact_delivery is unavailable because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Canonical owner count is 6, indicating cross-owner breadth.
Eight derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
Verified Change requires one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist; those conditions do
Compact Delivery requires visible approved UR, completed Brownfield analysis, and stored quick_task context; only the UR
Any impact beyond the bounded supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
